name: National Economic Register (NER) — login-gated
note: Federal unified company search (Ministry of Economy), across emirates + free zones. Login-gated; ner.economy.gov.ae NXDOMAIN. No open bulk/API. Do not bypass login.

name: Free-zone public registers — DIFC & ADGM (WAF/rate-limited)
note: DIFC + ADGM public registers of free-zone entities. Public via browser but WAF/rate-limited (DIFC 429; registration.adgm.com 403). No open download. Do not bypass WAF.

name: DFM & ADX — listed-company financials (browser; WAF/auth-gated)
note: Listed-company profiles + financial statements (AED). Public via browser; DFM data feeds auth-gated (connexions.dfm.ae); ADX 403 (WAF). Listed only (Emaar Properties PJSC, Emirates NBD PJSC, First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC). Do not bypass WAF/auth.
